cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a single ValidationMessage indicating that the instance node is null
cases.description: When both executionContext and node are null the method should guard against NPE and return an invalid result immediately.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage stating that executionContext is required
cases.description: If executionContext is null the method should fail early before any validator processing.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and empty message set
cases.description: When the schema has no required or type validators the method should simply walk the node and return a successful result.

group: Required validator present – missing required property

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage containing the missing required property name
cases.description: The schema declares a required property "missing". The node does not contain it, so the required validator should add a message.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage indicating expected type "string" but found "integer"
cases.description: The schema expects a string (has a TypeValidator for STRING). Providing an integer should trigger the type‑validation branch.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with recursiveAnchor flag set to true

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true (no infinite recursion) and no ValidationMessage about recursion depth
cases.description: When the schema is marked as a recursive anchor the method must detect and avoid re‑entering the same schema instance, returning a valid result for a self‑referencing node.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with WalkListenerRunner that throws WalkAbortException on first node

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage indicating walk was aborted by listener
cases.description: If a WalkListenerRunner is attached and it aborts the walk, the method should catch the abort and return a result reflecting the early termination.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a single ValidationMessage indicating that the instance node is null
cases.description: When the node argument is null but a non‑null ExecutionContext is supplied the method should guard against NPE and return an invalid result immediately.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage stating that the value "blue" is not one of the allowed enum values ["red","green","yellow"]
cases.description: The schema contains an enum validator with allowed values ["red","green","yellow"]. Providing a value outside this set should trigger the enum validation branch.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage indicating that the string "123-AB" does not match the pattern "^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{3}$"
cases.description: The schema defines a pattern validator expecting three uppercase letters followed by three digits. Supplying a non‑matching string should produce a pattern‑validation error.

group: $ref resolution – required property in referenced schema

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage mentioning missing required property "age" from the referenced schema
cases.description: The primary schema contains a $ref to another schema that declares a required property "age". The instance node lacks this property, so the validator must resolve the reference and report the missing required field.

group: Combined required + type validators – type passes, required fails

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage for missing required property "mandatory" (type validator succeeds because the node is an object)
cases.description: The schema defines a required property "mandatory" and a type validator that expects an object. The instance is an object (type passes) but does not contain the required field, so only the required‑validator message should appear.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage indicating that array element at index 1 is of type integer but expected string
cases.description: The schema specifies an array where each item must be a string. The second element is an integer, causing the items‑type validator to add an error for that index.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage stating that property "extra" is not allowed (additionalProperties = false)
cases.description: The schema defines "additionalProperties": false. The instance contains an unexpected property, which should be reported as a validation error.

group: WalkListenerRunner – listener adds custom message without aborting

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with WalkListenerRunner that records a custom ValidationMessage "listener‑info" for each visited node

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and a message set that includes the custom "listener‑info" messages (one per visited node) in addition to any schema‑generated messages (none in this case)
cases.description: When a WalkListenerRunner is present but does not abort the walk, it may inject additional ValidationMessages. The method should collect those messages together with the normal validation results.

group: ExecutionContext with custom CollectorContext – messages are aggregated correctly

input.value: mock ExecutionContext whose CollectorContext is pre‑populated with a custom scope that prefixes messages with "[custom]"

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a ValidationMessage prefixed with "[custom]" describing the type mismatch (expected string, found integer)
cases.description: The ExecutionContext can carry a CollectorContext that influences how messages are recorded. This test verifies that the custom scope is applied to the messages produced by the validator.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown from URLDecoder.decode indicating malformed percent‑encoding in $ref
cases.description: The schema includes a $ref with an illegal percent‑encoding sequence. When validateAndCollect attempts to resolve the reference it should trigger URLDecoder.decode which throws IllegalArgumentException. The method must let this exception surface.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with WalkListenerRunner that throws RuntimeException("listener failure") on first node

cases.expected: RuntimeException with message "listener failure" propagates out of validateAndCollect
cases.description: When a WalkListenerRunner attached to the schema throws an unexpected RuntimeException (not WalkAbortException), validateAndCollect should not swallow it; the exception must propagate to the caller.

group: Circular $ref without recursive anchor – recursion limit exception

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with schema that $ref‑s to itself and isRecursiveAnchor() returns false

cases.expected: ValidationException (or IllegalStateException) indicating recursion depth exceeded or circular reference detected
cases.description: A schema that references itself via $ref but is not marked as a recursive anchor should cause the validator to detect a circular reference and abort with a specific exception rather than entering an infinite recursion.

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with a custom JsonValidator that throws JsonProcessingException("invalid JSON") during validation

cases.expected: ValidationException (or RuntimeException) whose cause is JsonProcessingException with message "invalid JSON"
cases.description: If a JsonValidator invoked by validateAndCollect throws a JsonProcessingException, the method should wrap it in a higher‑level ValidationException (or rethrow as RuntimeException) so that callers can see the original cause.
